mapper.select: SELECT group_key, metric_scope, CAST(effective_start_at AS String) AS bucket_start, CAST(effective_end_at AS String) AS bucket_end, covered_seconds AS effective_seconds, total_started AS started_count, total_success AS success_count, total_failure AS failure_count, total_timeout AS timeout_count, total_cancelled AS cancelled_count, total_cache_read AS cache_read_count, total_cache_hit AS cache_hit_count, expert_count, interface_count, started_count / nullIf(effective_seconds, 0) AS average_qps, success_count / nullIf(effective_seconds, 0) AS success_tps, failure_count / nullIf(success_count + failure_count, 0) AS error_rate, timeout_count / nullIf(success_count + failure_count, 0) AS timeout_rate, cache_hit_count / nullIf(cache_read_count, 0) AS cache_hit_rate, if(total_latency_samples = 0, NULL, latency_quantiles[1]) AS p95_millis, if(total_latency_samples = 0, NULL, latency_quantiles[2]) AS p99_millis, total_latency_samples AS latency_sample_count FROM ( SELECT group_key, metric_scope, coverage.covered_start_at AS effective_start_at, coverage.covered_end_at AS effective_end_at, coverage.covered_seconds AS covered_seconds, sum(started_count) AS total_started, sum(success_count) AS total_success, sum(failure_count) AS total_failure, sum(timeout_count) AS total_timeout, sum(cancelled_count) AS total_cancelled, sum(cache_read_count) AS total_cache_read, sum(cache_hit_count) AS total_cache_hit, uniqExactIf(agent_id, metric_scope = 'EXECUTION' AND started_count > 0 AND agent_id != '') AS expert_count, uniqExactIf(interface_id, metric_scope = 'EXECUTION' AND started_count > 0) AS interface_count, sum(latency_sample_count) AS total_latency_samples, quantilesTDigestIfMerge(0.95, 0.99)(latency_state) AS latency_quantiles FROM ( SELECT metric_scope, agent_id, interface_id, started_count, success_count, failure_count, timeout_count, cancelled_count, cache_read_count, cache_hit_count, latency_sample_count, latency_state, toInt64(toUInt32(#{range.bucketSeconds})) * 1000 AS bucket_ms, multiIf(#{groupBy} = 'interface', interface_id, #{groupBy} = 'expert', agent_id, '') AS group_key, if(bucket_ms = 0, toInt64(0), intDiv(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(bucket_start) + 28800000, greatest(bucket_ms, 1)) * bucket_ms - 28800000) AS bucket_key FROM LQ13_DataGovernance.interface_monitor_offline_daily_all WHERE row_kind = 'METRIC' AND stat_date >= toDate(parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{range.startTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Shanghai') AND stat_date < toDate(parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{range.endTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Shanghai') AND bucket_start >= parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{range.startTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND bucket_start < parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{range.endTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND (#{interfaceId} = '' OR interface_id = #{interfaceId}) AND (#{agentId} = '' OR agent_id = #{agentId}) AND (toUInt8(#{unattributedOnly}) = 0 OR agent_id = '') ) AS metrics INNER JOIN ( SELECT if(toUInt32(#{range.bucketSeconds}) = 0, toInt64(0), intDiv(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(bucket_start) + 28800000, greatest(toInt64(toUInt32(#{range.bucketSeconds})) * 1000, 1)) * toInt64(toUInt32(#{range.bucketSeconds})) * 1000 - 28800000) AS coverage_key, min(bucket_start) AS covered_start_at, max(bucket_start + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS covered_end_at, count() * 600 AS covered_seconds FROM LQ13_DataGovernance.interface_monitor_offline_daily_all WHERE row_kind = 'COVERAGE' AND stat_date >= toDate(parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{range.startTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Shanghai') AND stat_date < toDate(parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{range.endTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Shanghai') AND bucket_start >= parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{range.startTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND bucket_start < parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{range.endTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') GROUP BY coverage_key ) AS coverage ON metrics.bucket_key = coverage.coverage_key GROUP BY group_key, metric_scope, metrics.bucket_key, coverage.covered_start_at, coverage.covered_end_at, coverage.covered_seconds ) ORDER BY group_key, bucket_start, metric_scope SETTINGS final = 1

SELECT CAST(first_at AS String) AS available_from, CAST(last_at AS String) AS available_through, effective_seconds, if(isNull(completed_at), NULL, CAST(assumeNotNull(completed_at) AS String)) AS statistics_completed_at FROM ( SELECT min(bucket_start) AS first_at, max(bucket_start + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS last_at, count() * 600 AS effective_seconds, maxOrNull(statistics_completed_at) AS completed_at FROM LQ13_DataGovernance.interface_monitor_offline_daily_all WHERE row_kind = 'COVERAGE' AND stat_date >= toDate(parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{startTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Shanghai') AND stat_date < toDate(parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{endTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Shanghai') AND bucket_start >= parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{startTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND bucket_start < parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{endTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') GROUP BY if(toUInt32(#{bucketSeconds}) = 0, toInt64(0), intDiv(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(bucket_start) + 28800000, greatest(toInt64(toUInt32(#{bucketSeconds})) * 1000, 1))) ) ORDER BY available_from SETTINGS final = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LQ13_DataGovernance.interface_monitor_offline_daily ( stat_date, bucket_start, row_kind, statistics_completed_at, interface_id, agent_id, metric_scope, started_count, success_count, failure_count, timeout_count, cancelled_count, cache_read_count, cache_hit_count, latency_sample_count, latency_state ) SELECT toDate(#{statDate}), fromUnixTimestamp64Milli( intDiv(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(occurred_at) + 28800000, 600000) * 600000 - 28800000, 'Asia/Shanghai' ) AS metric_bucket_start, 'METRIC', NULL, interface_id, agent_id, metric_scope, countIf(event_phase = 'START') AS started_count, countIf(event_phase = 'FINISH' AND outcome = 'SUCCESS') AS success_count, countIf(event_phase = 'FINISH' AND outcome = 'FAILURE') AS failure_count, countIf(event_phase = 'FINISH' AND outcome = 'FAILURE' AND failure_kind = 'TIMEOUT') AS timeout_count, countIf(event_phase = 'FINISH' AND outcome = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled_count, countIf(metric_scope = 'EXECUTION' AND event_phase = 'FINISH' AND cache_result IN ('HIT', 'MISS', 'READ_ERROR')) AS cache_read_count, countIf(metric_scope = 'EXECUTION' AND event_phase = 'FINISH' AND cache_result = 'HIT') AS cache_hit_count, countIf(event_phase = 'FINISH' AND outcome IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE') AND isNotNull(elapsed_millis)) AS latency_sample_count, quantilesTDigestIfState(0.95, 0.99)( ifNull(elapsed_millis, toUInt64(0)), event_phase = 'FINISH' AND outcome IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE') AND isNotNull(elapsed_millis) ) AS latency_state FROM LQ13_DataGovernance.interface_monitor_event FINAL WHERE occurred_date = toDate(#{statDate}) AND occurred_at >= toDateTime64(toDate(#{statDate}), 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND occurred_at < toDateTime64(addDays(toDate(#{statDate}), 1), 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND occurred_at < parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{coveredUntil}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND metric_bucket_start + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE <= parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{coveredUntil}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') GROUP BY metric_bucket_start, interface_id, agent_id, metric_scope

INSERT INTO LQ13_DataGovernance.interface_monitor_offline_daily ( stat_date, bucket_start, row_kind, statistics_completed_at, interface_id, agent_id, metric_scope, started_count, success_count, failure_count, timeout_count, cancelled_count, cache_read_count, cache_hit_count, latency_sample_count, latency_state ) SELECT toDate(#{statDate}), addMinutes(toDateTime64(toDate(#{statDate}), 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), toInt64(number) * 10) AS covered_bucket_start, 'COVERAGE', parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{statisticsCompletedAt}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), '', '', '', toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), quantilesTDigestIfState(0.95, 0.99)(toUInt64(0), toUInt8(0)) FROM numbers(144) WHERE covered_bucket_start + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE <= parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{coveredUntil}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') GROUP BY covered_bucket_start
